title: 第19章 抬手镇压筑基第20章 犯我天道宗者杀无赦
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费
content_zh:
这群人，足有上百人，全部穿着玄色长衫，每个人都散发着强横的气息。
为首的是一个长发披肩的老者，身形消瘦佝偻，但气息沉凝强横，隐约透出一种恐怖的压迫感。
其身后，有人举着一个旗帜，正迎风招展，上面绣着三个金灿灿的字。
灵琅宗！
如此声势浩荡的宗门势力出行，自然吸引了云水城的众人，其身后，远远跟着黑压压的吃瓜人群。
听到这个动静，后山修炼的肖岩与诸葛风都走了过来，当他们看见其旗帜时，皆目光凝重。
“灵霄宗附庸势力之一的灵琅宗！”
萧灵汐、诸葛风、肖岩皆是目光一变，很显然都听说过这个宗门。
只有刚来的叶青瑶，一脸茫然。
“这灵琅宗很厉害吗？”苏白笑问道。
“据我所知，灵霄宗为了扩大势力范围，收了几个附庸，这灵琅宗就是其中之一。”
“这灵琅宗，势力极大，已经入了仙盟之列，在整个大赵，都有极高的地位，不比我所在家族差。”
“据说其灵琅宗的老祖，已入了金丹真人之列，不知是真是假。”
萧灵汐缓缓解释道。
“灵琅宗竟然这般厉害......”肖岩与诸葛风心底震惊。
“我肖家在云水城属于大家族，有多位炼气修士，可与这灵琅宗比起来，犹如蝼蚁一般！”肖岩倒吸一口冷气。
灵琅宗已经这般厉害了，那灵霄宗又该有多强大？
“师尊......怎么办？”诸葛风凝重道。
“无妨。”苏白轻描淡写的说道。
他的神色始终未曾变化，目光俯视着山下，微风吹动他的衣襟腰带，带起了飘逸的弧线。

此时此刻，他像极了绝代的谪仙，俯瞰苍生。
一群人，大摇大摆入了天道宗的范围，一步一步朝山上而来。
片刻之后，领先在最前面的老者，便停住了身影。
那老者的目光，微微抬头，看到了苏白身旁的萧灵汐，眼神深处，带着丝丝阴翳。
“灵汐小姐，我等找你可是找的好苦啊！”
老者开口，声若洪钟，一股威严扑面而至，令人心中不由自主的生出一抹畏惧来。
筑基境！
筑基修士的气息太过浩瀚，哪怕只是简单的站在那里，都给人一种泰山压顶的感觉。
这等超级强者，哪怕仅仅只是一缕威压，都不是炼气期修士可以抗衡的。
天道宗这个小山头，恐怕足以被其一招夷平！
“灵汐小姐，请随老夫前往灵霄宗吧！”
content_en:
There were hundreds of people in this group, all wearing black gowns, and everyone exuded a strong aura.
The leader was an old man with long hair shawl. He was thin and stooped, but his aura was calm and powerful, vaguely revealing a sense of terrifying oppression.
Behind him, someone was holding a flag, fluttering in the wind, with three golden characters embroidered on it.
Linglang Sect!
The outing of such a powerful sect force naturally attracted everyone in Yunshui City. Behind it, there was a dark crowd of people eating melons.
Hearing this movement, Xiao Yan and Zhuge Feng, who were practicing in the back mountain, both came over. When they saw the flag, their eyes were solemn.
"Linglang Sect, one of the vassal forces of Lingxiao Sect!"
Xiao Lingxi, Zhuge Feng, and Xiao Yan all changed their looks. It was obvious that they had heard of this sect.
Only Ye Qingyao, who had just arrived, looked confused.
"Is this Linglang Sect very powerful?" Su Bai asked with a smile.
"As far as I know, Lingxiao Sect has accepted several vassals in order to expand its sphere of influence, and Linglang Sect is one of them."
"This Linglang Sect is extremely powerful and has already entered the Immortal Alliance. It has a very high status in the entire Zhao Dynasty, no worse than my family."
"It is said that the ancestor of his Linglang Sect has joined the ranks of Jindan Zhenren. I don't know whether it is true or not."
Xiao Lingxi slowly explained.
"Linglang Sect is so powerful..." Xiao Yan and Zhuge Feng were shocked.
"My Xiao family is a big family in Yunshui City, and there are many Qi Refining monks, but compared with this Linglang Sect, they are like ants!" Xiao Yan took a breath of air.
Linglang Sect is already so powerful, how powerful should Lingxiao Sect be?
"Master... what should I do?" Zhuge Feng said solemnly.
"It doesn't matter." Su Bai said lightly.
His expression never changed, his eyes looking down at the foot of the mountain, the breeze blowing his belt and creating an elegant arc.
At this moment, he looked like a peerless immortal, overlooking the common people.
A group of people swaggered into the territory of Tiandao Sect and walked towards the mountain step by step.
After a moment, the old man who was leading the front stopped.
The old man raised his eyes slightly and saw Xiao Lingxi next to Su Bai, with a hint of gloom deep in his eyes.
"Miss Lingxi, it was so hard for me to find you!"
When the old man opened his mouth, his voice was like a loud bell, and a majesty hit his face, making people involuntarily feel a sense of fear in their hearts.
Foundation building realm!
The breath of the foundation-building monk is so vast that even simply standing there gives people the feeling of being overwhelmed by a mountain.
Even if it is just a wisp of pressure from such a super strong person, it is not something that a monk in the Qi Refining Stage can contend with.
The hilltop of Tiandaozong might be enough to be flattened by one of his moves!
"Miss Lingxi, please follow me to Lingxiao Sect!"
